name: Modern Drupal Dashboard (Dash)
description: Provides a modern, React-powered administrative dashboard with key site insights and health indicators.
project_description: Modern Drupal Dashboard (dash) provides a clean, React-powered administrative dashboard for Drupal 10.3+ and Drupal 11. It replaces the default admin landing experience with a fast, widget-based single-page interface served at /admin/dashboard that surfaces content statistics, user and role breakdowns, an entity inventory, module insights, system/status information, and category health scores (SEO, performance, accessibility, security) with dedicated detail pages. All data is computed server-side by isolated PHP services and delivered as cacheable JSON to the React app; each widget is gated behind the restricted 'access modern dashboard' permission. No configuration is required.
